description: Four 3/2 core frames with an XXCH extension that adds a pair of rear channels (DTS-ES 7.1, XXCH), written in 16-bit words, little endian.

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's decoder rejects the XXCH stub, whose channel set data is filler (dca_core.c: 'DSYNC check failed'), so ffprobe gets 5 channels from the core and no profile of the extension
skip.decode: The XXCH channel set data is filler, which ffmpeg rejects at its DSYNC check.
